proposal.quote: See for example Section 8 of the Neutrality Act of May 1, 1937.
proposal.rule: claude backend: The Secretary of State cites the Neutrality Act of 1 May 1937 as the law in force, which fits the isolationist level (the Neutrality Act regime). The passage does not mention the arms embargo itself.
